description: Search serving IANA timezone identifiers and their pinned rule edition. Filter by country, IANA area, exact offset, abbreviation or DST facts at one instant. Abbreviations return candidate identifiers and never choose a timezone. Empty timezones means no match. Details adds aligned rows and the evaluation instant. One pooled request.

abbreviation.description: Timezone abbreviation to find candidates for, e.g. CST. Never infer a unique zone from an abbreviation.

at.description: ISO instant for all filters and detailed rows. Default now. Offsetless input means UTC.

details.description: Include zones rows with country associations, area, offset, abbreviation and DST facts, plus the common evaluation instant.

dst.description: Whether the rule DST flag is active at the selected instant. Includes negative seasonal adjustments.

observes_dst.description: Whether a DST-flagged state occurs during the UTC calendar year containing at.

offset.description: Exact UTC offset at the selected instant, e.g. +05:45 or +00:09:21.

query.description: Identifier search, e.g. New York or Europe. Spaces and underscores match the same way.

sort.description: Order by identifier (default) or actual UTC offset, then identifier.

name: time_zones
